title: coap_status.c: strnlen implicit declaration + sign-compare -Werror breaks 4.1.0 build
description: Last remaining ping_l2 build error after the recv_async port (0l5j), found on heft native_sim/native/64 against Zephyr 4.1.0. lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_status.c:495 implicit declaration of strnlen (missing include - new toolchain/headers no longer pull it transitively; did-you-mean strlen), :496 and :498 sign-compare int vs long unsigned [-Werror=sign-compare]. Fix: include <string.h> and use size_t for the strnlen results (or cast the comparison operand). Blocks 5fva.* runtime debugging (same class as the 6zj1 send_mutex port).
close_reason: Fixed: strnlen replaced with a static status_bounded_len(s,max) memchr helper in coap_status.c (Zephyr minimal libc does not declare strnlen; implicit-function-declaration + sign-compare -Werror broke the 4.1.0 build). Both sides of the source_class/source_name validity comparisons are now size_t. Equivalence proven by review: exact-fit and non-terminated buffers still fail (>= max), empty and NUL-terminated strings still pass; memchr bounded by sizeof cannot over-read; fixed char-array members can never be NULL. VERIFIED on heft: ping_l2 native_sim/native/64 now BUILDS, LINKS and RUNS for the first time on this workspace - 4/7 tests pass; the 3 runtime failures are exactly the 5fva child beads' scope (test_full_l2_loopback_ping = 5fva.1, test_l2_publish_app_identity_uses_link_context_key = 5fva.2, test_udp_payload_reaches_socket_after_l2_injection = 5fva.3); fresh runtime evidence posted to 5fva.1 (TX failure symptom drifted -ENOENT -> -126 on the 4.1.0 stack; lichen_link_strerror lacks a -126 entry too). Review: pass 1 PASS + scope note (sibling coap_config/coap_rangetest/coap_waypoint strnlen uses filed as wmae P2), passes 2-3 PASS (no over-read; validation strength unchanged; no implicit-int semantic dependencies).
